comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Can't actually get the job until Gran Atlas arrives, but you -can- get an early start towards it. The job card quest apparently comes at the end of a multi-part quest chain; the first part of that chain is available as of the Midnight Sun patch. It's called:

Country of Pirates - Santo Domingo Maritime guild
7 star difficulty, with the following steps:

1. [Nassau] pirate messenger conversation x2.
2. [Nassau] black businessman conversation pay x2.
3. [Jamaica] pier officials talk x2.

Note that the NPC names are taken from a Japanese-to-English translation, and undoubtedly differ from the names used in GAMA. (Pier Official = Port Official, for example.) I'm afraid I couldn't find a fame requirement for the quest on any of my usual haunts, or I'd list that as well.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The quest I'm talking about ("Country of Pirates") doesn't appear to have any battles, and should only be a 'talk to these NPCs to complete it' kind of quest. The job card quest will definitely have a target fleet, though I know nothing about its specifics at this time. Additionally, the "Country of Pirates" quest awards 1,035,200 ducats upon completion, which very helpfully covers the price of admission to Nassau for non-pirate players.

Agreed on the skills, too. It's a shame repair isn't favored, but I suppose the reason could be that a Grand Admiral would be too busy directing their fleets in battle to be bothered with patching up battle damage. Ah, the perks of leadership: delegating responsibilities to others.

comments.author: Ezio
comments.body:
You have to first have Charted the Antilles region from the Mercator.

After that look for the quest "Country of Pirates" in Santo Domingo MT guy by the bank. As stated above only requirement is English. Bring LOTS of QMP's.

Because it's a Chrono quest, you cannot share it with anyone in fleet, so everyone has to pull it separately.

"Request from Port Royal" or something to that effect is the next quest also from Santo Domingo. Requirements are the same as previous, (make sure you've charted the sea region), and bring lots of QMP's. After that you can open Port Royal.

"Governor-General's Plan" is the next quest, also taken in Santo Domingo.

"Gold smuggling ship attack plan" is the rough translation of the next quest, also taken from Santo Domingo.

"World where pirates live" is the final quest taken in LONDON maritime guild. It will make you sail back to Port Royale for the remainder of the quest.

After these are completed you'll get the job card for Grand Admiral. :)

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
In order to get the job card again, the following quest is the subsequent of "The World of Pirates" called "A commission from Henry Morgan".

This is an 17-4 Chrono quest with 9 star difficulty with as reward 310.000 D, 62.000 D (advanced) and the job card of grand admiral.

You need to defeat about 20 Random Buccanneers which consist Heavy Galleons (normal shots) and Refitted Heavy Carrack (Chain-shots) at (12687;3977). It is recommended to have decent melee stats and armour at least 90 or higher.
